items.detail: grep -n 'metrics/prom' README.md -> exactly 1 hit: `170:| `GET` | `/metrics/prom` | Prometheus text exposition (`text/plain; version=0.0.4`) of the `obo_*` meter families — always answers 200 and never 404s, unlike `/metrics`, which returns 404 when the metrics observer is disabled |`. The row sits inside the System table: header `### System` at README.md:161, table header/separator at 163-164, rows 165-170, blank line 171. BEFORE (rows 165-169): taxonomy, stats, openapi.json, health, `/metrics` (404 when observer disabled). AFTER: same five rows plus the new `/metrics/prom` row at 170. Table is well-formed — awk pipe count on line 170 = 4, identical to line 169. REJECTS honored: `git show ae5c0280 --name-only` = `README.md` only (no pkg/api/openapi.yaml, no docs/observability-spec.md); the existing GET /metrics row is preserved unchanged at README.md:169 (`grep -c '^| `GET` | `/metrics' README.md` = 2, i.e. both rows present); the commit diff is 1 insertion, 0 deletions. Claims are source-backed, not invented: internal/api/server.go:185 registers `mux.HandleFunc("GET /metrics/prom", s.handleMetricsProm)`; server.go:397-399 delegates to nil-safe `s.Prom.Handler()`; server.go:380-384 `handleMetrics` returns `http.StatusNotFound, "metrics_disabled"` when `s.Observer == nil`, which is exactly the contrast the row states. Content type confirmed by test: `go test ./internal/api/ -run 'MetricsProm|OpenAPI' -count=1 -v` -> `--- PASS: TestMetricsPromNilSafe`, `--- PASS: TestMetricsPromEndpoint`, `--- PASS: TestMetricsPromReadOnlyPassthrough`, `ok github.com/totalwindupflightsystems/off-by-one/internal/api 0.023s`; metrics_prom_test.go:96-105 asserts status 200 and `Content-Type` prefix `text/plain; version=0.0.4` on a bare `&Server{}`. Broader run `go test ./internal/api/ ./internal/metrics/ -count=1` -> `ok ... internal/api 0.737s`, `ok ... internal/metrics 0.445s`. The row also agrees with the pre-existing spec at pkg/api/openapi.yaml:493-515 (`'text/plain; version=0.0.4'`, never 404s), so no contradiction was introduced. [resolution 0.27; README.md, pkg/api/openapi.yaml, docs/observability-spec.md]

findings.detection: task status in .gitreins/tasks.yaml disagrees with the same task's status in .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl
findings.detail: README-9 is recorded as `status: complete` with completed_at 2026-11-17T02:22:43Z in .gitreins/tasks.yaml, while the same diff sets README-9 to `"status":"in_progress"` in .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl and emits a task_updated in_progress event (id 694) for it — the two task stores now contradict each other for the same id.

findings.detection: status transition to in_progress recorded without the worktree/branch fields the sibling rows in the same change carry
findings.detail: OBS-OB-004, REVIEW-OB-024, RELEASE-OB-021, DOC-8 and README-9 are all flipped to in_progress in one batch, but only some rows gain `worktree`/`branch` (OBS-OB-004, RELEASE-OB-021, REVIEW-OB-024, DOC-8, README-9) while the corresponding .gitreins/tasks.yaml entries for the same ids carry no worktree/branch at all, so the two stores disagree on dispatch metadata as well as status.

review.summary: Board-only bookkeeping change that flips five rows to in_progress, but the two task stores it writes (.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl and .gitreins/tasks.yaml) end up disagreeing on README-9's status and on worktree/branch metadata.
